StatDef.label: waste output factor
StatDef.description: Waste relative to the original output for this pawn. 100% means unchanged output.

StatDef.label: waste per use (toilet / latrine)
StatDef.description: Expected sewage generated by one regular toilet or latrine use, before capacity and disposal handling.

StatDef.label: waste per use (advanced toilet)
StatDef.description: Expected sewage generated by one advanced toilet use.

StatDef.label: waste per use (outdoors)
StatDef.description: Expected sewage added to the ground by one outdoor defecation. Does not include separate filth objects.
